title: Can Claude replace Bitly? 19/19 checks, 69 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Bitly alternative, a link shortener on your own domain with a UTM builder, QR codes and click counts that leave out bots and link previews, from one written spec: all 19 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 69 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:48): https://youtu.be/tBud8dlU-nI
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/link-shortener
Bitly pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/bitly

Bitly prices, billed annually: Core $10, Growth $29 and Premium $199 a month; changing where a link points is limited to 5, 20 or 110 times a month on those plans, and multiple users are an Enterprise addition (bitly.com/pages/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
